name: Times club monthly special crossword No 20,223

solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing; the grid proves the blog's enumeration wrong at 21 down, recounted from the answer here

clue.text: Gone in moments? Not from my recall!

definitions.text: Gone in moments? Not from my recall!

indicators.note: something gone has fallen apart, so the letters that follow are broken up and rearranged

blocks.note: both words taken as written, giving nine letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: Someone admits a memory has vanished in an instant, adding that it was never theirs to lose.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as a whole, the clue is the boast of a memory performer: the recall on show belongs to a specialist, not to an ordinary forgetful speaker.
explanation.definitionFit: A mnemonist is a performer with a trained, prodigious memory, the kind of feat ordinary people cannot manage.

clue.text: Norse giant runs under noted TB-ridden sewer

indicators.note: in a down entry, putting one piece under another means it is written after it

blocks.note: Mimi, the seamstress in Puccini's La Bohème, dies of tuberculosis; 'noted' hints at the opera
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A tale of a giant from Norse myth lurking beneath a diseased drain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sewer' looks like a drain, but it is someone who sews: the consumptive seamstress of La Bohème.
explanation.definitionFit: Mimir is the wise being of Norse mythology, often counted among the giants, whose head Odin consulted for counsel.

clue.text: Goon evacuated into nearby pub welcomes soldier concerned with church buildings?

indicators.note: an evacuated word has had its insides emptied, leaving only its first and last letters
to welcome someone is to take them in, so one piece goes inside another

blocks.note: Eccles was a character in the British radio comedy The Goon Show
the word emptied of its middle letters
a local is the pub near one's home
GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A Goon Show performer is taken off to the pub nearby, where a soldier is greeted.
explanation.walkthrough: The Goon Show was a 1950s BBC radio comedy. The question mark flags that ecclesiology covers church fabric and furnishings as well as doctrine.
explanation.definitionFit: Ecclesiology includes the study of church architecture and furnishings, so the adjective describes interest in such buildings.

clue.text: Making mountains of rice, go on boiling

indicators.note: boiling water churns everything about, so the letters are tossed into a new order

blocks.note: all three words taken as written

explanation.surface: A cook making a huge heap of rice keeps the pot on the boil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Making mountains of rice' reads like overcooking a dish; 'of' only joins the definition to the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Orogenic describes orogeny, the geological folding and uplift of the earth's crust that forms mountain ranges.

clue.text: Current house-sitters making repairs (for a wing)

blocks.note: I is the physics symbol for electric current
Members of Parliament sit in the House of Commons

explanation.surface: People minding a house at present are carrying out repairs on one wing of it.
explanation.walkthrough: The house-sitters are not caretakers but MPs sitting in the House. In falconry, to imp is to graft new feathers into a hawk's damaged wing.
explanation.definitionFit: In falconry, imping is mending a bird's broken flight feathers by splicing in replacement ones.

clue.text: Note echo reduced in check for top of rampart

indicators.note: reduced means cut down, so the last letter of the word is dropped
in places the shortened word inside the following one

blocks.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale
to rein in is to check or restrain
an echo is a reply or answer

explanation.surface: A soldier on the ramparts checks a musical note's echo, which comes back weaker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Check' looks like a verb about inspecting the echo, but it supplies a noun-like piece for the shortened word to sit inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A terreplein is the flat platform on top of a rampart where guns are mounted, a fortification term.

clue.text: Hydrophobia clears pub and couples outside, as Perth’s wet

indicators.note: clears means removes, so those letters are taken away from the long word

blocks.note: taken as written
PH is an abbreviation for public house
the pair of letters at each end of the long word

explanation.surface: A fear of water empties the bar and sends couples outside, since it is raining in Perth.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove PH from the middle and HY and IA from the ends. Perth here is the Western Australian city, and a droob is Australian slang for a hopeless, dreary person.
explanation.definitionFit: In Australian slang a droob is a drip, a feeble or dismal person, just as British slang calls such a person a wet.

clue.text: To cover hoop, mostly taking in silk fabric

indicators.note: to cover something here is to wrap round it, so one piece goes outside the other
mostly means not quite all, so the last letter of the phrase is dropped

blocks.note: taking someone in is duping or deceiving them
a hoop is a ring, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: Someone sewing a cover for a hoop uses mostly silk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Taking in' looks like a dressmaker's alteration, but it means fooling: DUPING loses its G and wraps round the O.
explanation.definitionFit: Dupion is a coarse silk woven from the doubled thread of cocoons spun jointly by two silkworms.

clue.text: Scandalous hypocrisy on cost for ingrowing toenail

indicators.note: a scandalous display is shocking and disordered, so the letters are thrown into a new arrangement

blocks.note: all three words taken as written, fifteen letters in all

explanation.surface: Someone complains about the outrageous double standards over what treatment for an ingrowing toenail costs.
explanation.definitionFit: Onychocryptosis is the medical term for a toenail growing into the surrounding skin, from Greek for hidden nail.

clue.text: Plain Philippine president shortened ceremonial canopy

indicators.note: shortened means cut down by its final letter

blocks.note: a bald statement is a plain one
Corazon and Benigno Aquino were presidents of the Philippines

explanation.surface: A plain-speaking Philippine president was cut short at a ceremony under a canopy.
explanation.definitionFit: A baldaquin, or baldachin, is a canopy of state held over an altar, throne or procession.

clue.text: Leaf in pool: Olympics and even parts of archery spoiled

indicators.note: even parts are the letters in second, fourth and sixth places of the next word
spoiled means ruined, so all these letters are broken up and rebuilt

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written
the second, fourth and sixth letters

explanation.surface: A leaf floats in the swimming pool, and the Olympic archery events are ruined.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leaf in pool' reads as debris in the water; 'in' merely joins the definition to the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A microsporophyll is the specialised leaf of a plant such as a fern or conifer that bears the small spore sacs.

clue.text: Cutting from alstroemeria in large glass

indicators.note: a cutting is a piece snipped off a plant, so the letters are taken from within the flower's name

blocks.note: the run of letters from the fifth to the tenth

explanation.surface: A gardener puts a cutting of alstroemeria, a lily-like flower, in a big glass vase.
explanation.walkthrough: The plant-cutting picture fits the indicator neatly; the large glass is a drinking vessel, not a vase.
explanation.definitionFit: A roemer is a large German or Dutch drinking goblet for wine, with a broad bowl and studded stem.

clue.text: Foreign elements in framework overturned vote for Houses of Parliament on core of Brexit

indicators.note: overturned means turned upside down, so in an across entry the whole string runs from right to left
the core is the central part, so only the middle letters are kept

blocks.note: ay is a variant of aye, a vote in favour
HP is the abbreviation for Houses of Parliament
taken as written
the two central letters of the six

explanation.surface: A vote in Parliament on Brexit is overturned, as foreign interference is suspected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Foreign elements in framework' is the whole definition, so the parliamentary vote is wordplay only, and the reversal applies to the full string of four pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Xenophya are foreign particles, such as sand grains, that some protozoa incorporate into their shells or skeletal framework.

clue.text: Garden site authority constrained by Lutheran’s half-heartedness

indicators.note: something constrained is held in, so these pieces sit inside the following word

blocks.note: Luth is a standard abbreviation for Lutheran
Kew Gardens is the Royal Botanic Gardens in south-west London
the arm of the law is its authority or power

explanation.surface: A Lutheran's reluctance blocks a gardening authority's plans for a site.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe s on 'Lutheran's' only joins the wordplay to the definition, much like 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Lukewarmth is lukewarmness, a lack of enthusiasm or zeal, as in a feeling neither hot nor cold.

clue.text: Notably flipping round, I hobnob in Europe with cunning

indicators.note: flipping something turns it over, so the run of pieces is read backwards
in places the turned pieces inside the abbreviation

blocks.note: a round shape is like the letter O
taken as written
to hobnob is to mix socially
EU is the European Union
sly means cunning

explanation.surface: Someone notes that, turning round, they mingle shrewdly with Europeans.
explanation.walkthrough: The reversal covers 'round, I hobnob' together, and that whole turned run sits between the two letters of the Europe abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Eximious means excellent or distinguished, so eximiously means in an outstanding, remarkable manner.

clue.text: Record hourly limits to testify in old magistrate’s office

indicators.note: the limits of a word are its boundaries, so only its first and last letters count

blocks.note: an EP is an extended-play record
horal is a rare adjective meaning relating to hours
the first and last letters

explanation.surface: Someone records every hour in court, within limits, the testimony given at an old magistrate's office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hourly limits' looks like a pair, but 'limits' belongs with 'to testify'; horal is a dictionary rarity for hourly.
explanation.definitionFit: An ephor was one of five annual magistrates of ancient Sparta, and ephoralty is that post or term.

clue.text: For commentator, top-class rowers showing natural colour

indicators.note: a commentator speaks, so the words are judged by how they are spoken

blocks.note: an A crew is the first-class rowing team

explanation.surface: A race commentator describes the best rowers and the colour of their kit.
explanation.definitionFit: Ecru is the pale greyish-yellow shade of unbleached linen or silk, a natural, undyed tone.

clue.text: Artist called up fine source for Götterdämmerung

indicators.note: in a down entry, going up means the word is read from bottom to top

blocks.note: RA is a Royal Academician
rang means telephoned or called
OK means fine

explanation.surface: A painter phoned with good news about the origin of Wagner's opera.
explanation.walkthrough: Only 'called' is turned over by 'up'; the artist and 'fine' stay as they are.
explanation.definitionFit: Ragnarok is the doom of the gods in Norse myth, the story Wagner drew on for his opera Götterdämmerung.

clue.text: Tree frog first excluded from major taxonomic groups

indicators.note: the opening letter is left out of the word that follows

blocks.note: phyla are the major divisions of the animal kingdom

explanation.surface: A tree frog was at first left out of the main classification groups.
explanation.definitionFit: Hyla is the genus of typical tree frogs, climbing amphibians with adhesive toe pads.

clue.text: Turkish liquor seller sent over that old nuclear containment structure

indicators.note: something sent over is turned the other way, so these words run backwards

blocks.note: raki is an aniseed spirit drunk in Turkey
a rep is a sales representative
yon is an archaic word for that

explanation.surface: A dealer in Turkish spirits shipped them off to an old nuclear facility.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nuclear' points not to a reactor but to the cell nucleus, and the reversal covers the liquor and the seller together.
explanation.definitionFit: A perikaryon is the cell body of a neuron, the part surrounding and holding the nucleus.

clue.text: Group for rodents and lagomorphs needing pre-euro amounts in guineas

indicators.note: in places the money inside the abbreviation

blocks.note: G is an abbreviation for guinea, an old British coin worth 21 shillings
the lira was Italy's currency before the euro

explanation.surface: A zoological society needs old Italian money held in guineas to fund its work.
explanation.definitionFit: Glires is the clade uniting rodents with rabbits and hares, the gnawing mammals.

clue.text: Royal backing to arrest antiquer

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the following words are read in reverse

blocks.note: to nail a criminal is to catch or arrest them
something that antiques, or makes old, is an ager

explanation.surface: Royal support is given for the arrest of an antiques dealer.
explanation.walkthrough: An antiquer is not a dealer here but anything that ages; NAIL AGER read backwards gives REGALIAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Regalian means relating to a sovereign's rights or prerogatives, so it is a formal synonym of kingly.

clue.text: Soothing voice’s last thing needed in veteran clown

indicators.note: the last thing in the word is its final letter
needed in means put into, so one piece goes inside the other

blocks.note: antic is an archaic word for a clown or buffoon
the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: An old clown's soothing patter needs one last thing: the right voice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Veteran' marks the word as old-fashioned rather than describing an aged performer.
explanation.definitionFit: Anetic is a rare medical word for calming or relieving pain, the same sense as soothing.

clue.text: Police Department catching villain at last with a Stinger

indicators.note: at last points to the final letter of the word before it
catching means holding, so one piece goes inside the other

blocks.note: the CID is the Criminal Investigation Department of British police
the final letter
taken as written

explanation.surface: Detectives finally catch the criminal with help from an undercover sting.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital S on 'Stinger' disguises a literal stinging cell as a police operation.
explanation.definitionFit: A cnida is the stinging cell of jellyfish and sea anemones, which fires a barbed thread.

clue.text: Specifically muscle in to work when others are out

definitions.text: to work when others are out

blocks.note: sc. is short for scilicet, Latin for namely or specifically
an ab is an abdominal muscle

explanation.surface: A gym-goer specifically wants to work on a muscle while everyone else is away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Others are out' means on strike, not absent from the gym.
explanation.definitionFit: To scab is to act as a strikebreaker, taking work while fellow employees are on strike.

clue.text: Personnel wearing frilly waterproof shirt, ruined by one sweet wine

indicators.note: something wearing a garment is inside it, so one piece sits within another
ruined means wrecked, so the word's letters are jumbled into a new order

blocks.note: frilly trimming is lacy
HR, human resources, is the personnel department
a mac, or mackintosh, is a raincoat
the word's letters rearranged
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A personnel officer in a frilly raincoat gets their shirt stained by a sweet wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Frilly waterproof' looks like one garment, but frilly and waterproof give separate pieces; Lachryma Christi is Latin for tears of Christ.
explanation.definitionFit: Lachryma Christi is a wine from the slopes of Vesuvius near Naples, traditionally made in a sweet style.

clue.text: Cheerful one leaves, returning provincial prepares for Thatcher

indicators.note: leaves means departs, so that letter is taken out of the word
returning means going back, so the remaining letters are read in reverse

blocks.note: smiley means cheerful
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A cheerful country politician walks out as the region gets ready for Mrs Thatcher.
explanation.walkthrough: Thatcher is a roof-thatcher, not the prime minister; 'provincial' marks the word as dialect.
explanation.definitionFit: In dialect, to yelm is to lay out straw in straightened bundles ready for a roof thatcher to use.

clue.text: Bomb survivor greeting Azerbaijan city’s expression of triumph

blocks.note: hi is a greeting
Baku is the capital of Azerbaijan, with the possessive s
ha is an exclamation of triumph

explanation.surface: Someone who lived through a bombing greets Baku with a cry of victory.
explanation.definitionFit: Hibakusha is the Japanese term for survivors of the atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.
